## Overview

Chip is a compact control for filtering, choosing and tagging: a rounded row that pairs a required label with an optional secondary line, an optional leading icon **or** leading image, and a trailing slot. Four variant axes drive it. `Selected` carries the real value (on or off). `State` covers the five interaction states. `Size` scales height, padding, glyphs and type together; the 8 px gap between each slot and the label is the same at every size. `Type` decides what the trailing slot is: a decorative icon (`Default`) or a separate remove button (`Removable`).

The single structural idea worth knowing: **the border is a layer, not a variant.** It is an absolutely positioned `Border` rectangle stretched over the chip, toggled by the `Show border` boolean, so switching it off hides only the stroke and keeps the fill. That lets one chip serve both canvases without doubling the variant count:

| Canvas | Border | Why |
|---|---|---|
| White page or card (`bg`, `bg-surface-secondary`) | On | A white chip on white has no edge without it. |
| Grey page (`bg-secondary`) | Off | The white chip already stands off the grey, the way a card does. |

Focus is drawn by a dedicated ring rectangle outside the auto-layout flow, as on Button and Checkbox, so showing focus never reflows a row of chips.

**Variant axes.** 4 axes across 60 variants — **Size** (Small, Medium, Large; default `Medium`); **State** (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled; default `Default`); **Selected** (False, True; default `False`); **Type** (Default, Removable; default `Default`).

### Composition

- **Chip / Image** (constitutive — set `598:2889`, `Shape=Circle` is `557:64`, `Shape=Square` is `598:2887`) — placeholder for the leading image, filled with a sample photo of a passenger jet in a blue sky (by John McArthur, Unsplash License) so mocks read as travel. Created for this component and shared with Chip / Vertical.
- **Chip / Remove** (constitutive — `557:2481`, 24 variants: Size × State × Selected) — the remove button of a removable chip. Created for this component.
- **Icon / plus** (referenced — `55:11`) — default leading icon.
- **Icon / chevron-down** (referenced — `557:61`) — default trailing icon. Created for this component.
- **Icon / close** (referenced — `55:17`) — the remove glyph.
- _Decorative children: 2 (Border, Focus Ring) — documented under Structure._

## API

> `Selected` and `State` are not the same kind of thing. `Selected` is the chip value and maps to a real prop. `State` is design-only: `Hover`, `Pressed` and `Focus` exist so a mock can show them, but in code they are `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible`, owned by the component. Only `State=Disabled` maps to a prop.
>
> `Type=Removable` is not a style. It adds a second interactive element, with its own focus stop and its own action.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | (string) | – | Visible text. The design source ships "Label" as placeholder copy, not a runtime default. |
| `secondaryText` | string | (string) | `none` | Supporting line under the label, such as a price or a date. When absent, the node is not rendered. |
| `selected` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | The chip value. Maps to Figma `Selected`. |
| `size` | enum | small \| medium \| large | `medium` | Scales height, padding, glyphs and type together. |
| `bordered` | boolean | true \| false | `true` | Maps to Figma `Show border`. Choose by canvas, not by taste: on for white, off for `bg-secondary`. |
| `leadingIcon` | icon | (icon) | `none` | Glyph before the label. Mutually exclusive with `leadingImage`. |
| `leadingImage` | image | (source) | `none` | Image before the label: avatar, flag, airline logo, destination photo. Mutually exclusive with `leadingIcon`. |
| `imageShape` | enum | circle \| square | `circle` | Shape of the leading image. Maps to the exposed Figma `Shape`. |
| `trailingIcon` | icon | (icon) | `none` | Decorative glyph after the label, usually a chevron for a chip that opens a menu. Ignored when `onRemove` is set. |
| `onRemove` | callback | (function) | `none` | Makes the chip removable (Figma `Type=Removable`) and renders the remove button in the trailing slot. |
| `disabled` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Applies the disabled treatment and makes the chip, and its remove button, non-interactive. |

### Figma-only properties

These exist on the component set so a designer can configure every slot from the right-hand inspector:

| Figma property | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | TEXT | `"Label"` | Placeholder copy. |
| `Show secondary text` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Toggles the secondary line. The chip grows to two lines. |
| `Secondary text` | TEXT | `"Secondary text"` | Placeholder copy. |
| `Show leading icon` | BOOLEAN | `false` | |
| `Leading icon` | INSTANCE_SWAP | `Icon / plus` | Preferred values: the Icon set. The swapped icon keeps the chip icon colour. |
| `Show leading image` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Turn on the icon **or** the image, never both. |
| `Leading image` | INSTANCE_SWAP | `Chip / Image` | To swap from the inspector, build a component with the same structure (a frame clipping an `Image` layer) and add it to the preferred values. To change a single photo, select the nested `Image` layer and replace its fill. |
| `Shape` (exposed from `Leading image`) | VARIANT | `Circle` | The leading image is an exposed nested instance, so its `Shape` (Circle or Square) shows in the chip panel. Circle for avatars, flags and airline logos; Square for destination or hotel photos. |
| `Show trailing icon` | BOOLEAN | `false` | `Type=Default` only. |
| `Trailing icon` | INSTANCE_SWAP | `Icon / chevron-down` | Preferred values: the Icon set. |
| `Show border` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Hides the `Border` layer only; the fill stays. |
| `Remove` | Nested instance | `State=Default` | `Type=Removable` only. Exposed, so its `State` (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus) can be set from the chip inspector to mock hovering the remove button. |

### Examples

| # | Configuration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `label="Non-stop"` | Unselected filter chip. |
| 2 | `label="Morning"`, `selected`, `leadingIcon=check` | Selected filter chip. The check makes the selection visible without relying on colour. |
| 3 | `label="Price"`, `trailingIcon=chevron-down` | Chip that opens a sort or filter menu. |
| 4 | `label="IndiGo"`, `leadingImage=<logo>` | Airline filter. |
| 5 | `label="Fri, 12 Dec"`, `secondaryText="Rs 4,532"`, `selected` | Date and fare picker. |
| 6 | `label="Goa"`, `onRemove`, `selected` | Removable tag, e.g. a chosen destination. |

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Chip (component set · 559:2943)
├─ Focus Ring (rectangle) · decorative · a11y-hidden · absolute, 4 px outside the chip
├─ Border (rectangle) · decorative · absolute, stretched to the chip · toggled by Show border
├─ Leading image (instance · Chip / Image · exposed, so its Shape is set from the chip panel) · hidden by default
├─ Leading icon (instance · Icon / plus) · a11y-hidden · hidden by default
├─ Text (frame · vertical)
│  ├─ Label (text)
│  └─ Secondary text (text) · hidden by default
└─ Trailing icon (instance · Icon / chevron-down) · a11y-hidden · Type=Default, hidden by default
   or Remove (instance · Chip / Remove) · Type=Removable · its own focus stop
```

The root is a horizontal auto-layout row, `counterAxisAlignItems = CENTER`, hug width, `minHeight` bound, `clipsContent = false` so the focus ring can overhang. With the secondary line on, icons and the remove button stay centred on the two-line text block.

### Dimensions

`Size` is the only dimension-affecting axis. `State`, `Selected` and `Type` leave every measurement identical.

| Property | Small | Medium | Large | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Min height (one line) | 28 | 32 | 40 | `chip/min-height-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Height with secondary line | 40 | 44 | 60 | hugs content |
| Padding x | 8 | 12 | 16 | `chip/padding-x-*` |
| Padding y | 4 | 4 | 8 | `chip/padding-y-*` |
| Gap between each slot and the label | 8 | 8 | 8 | `chip/gap` |
| Icon and remove glyph | 16 | 20 | 24 | `chip/icon-size-*` |
| Leading image | 16 | 20 | 24 | `chip/image-size-*` |
| Label type | 12 / 16 bold | 14 / 20 bold | 16 / 24 bold | `label/{small,medium,large}/bold` |
| Secondary type | 12 / 16 regular | 12 / 16 regular | 14 / 20 regular | `body/{small,small,medium}/regular` |
| Label to secondary gap | 0 | 0 | 0 | `chip/gap-text` |
| Corner radius | 8 | 8 | 12 | `chip/radius-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Leading image radius, Circle | full | full | full | `chip/image-radius` |
| Leading image radius, Square | 4 | 4 | 4 | `chip/image-radius-square` |
| Border width | 1 | 1 | 1 | `chip/border-width` |
| Focus ring outset | 4 | 4 | 4 | `chip/focus-ring-offset` (2) + `chip/focus-ring-width` (2) |
| Focus ring radius | 12 | 12 | 16 | `chip/focus-ring-radius-{sm,md,lg}` — always the chip radius plus 4, so the ring stays concentric |

Glyphs never set the height: Medium 20 px glyphs sit inside a 24 px content box (32 − 4 − 4) and Large 24 px glyphs fill theirs exactly (40 − 8 − 8), so both chips keep their min-height.

The label is bold in every state, including selected, so selecting a chip never changes its width and a row of chips never jumps.

## Color

Token names follow `chip/{property}-{selection}-{state}`. `State=Focus` reuses the `default` colour suffix and adds the ring; focus changes nothing but the ring.

### Container fill — `chip/bg-*`

| Selected | Default | Hover | Pressed | Disabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| False | `color.bg-fill` | `color.bg-fill-hover` | `color.bg-fill-pressed-subtle` | `color.bg-surface-disabled-subtle` |
| True | `color.bg-surface-brand` | `color.bg-surface-brand-hover` | `color.bg-surface-brand-pressed` | `color.bg-surface-disabled-subtle` |

`bg-fill-hover` and `bg-fill-pressed-subtle` were added to the semantic tier for this component. Both are `neutral.100`, the same grey as `bg-secondary` (1.00:1): hover and pressed share one fill and differ only by the border (pressed darkens it to `border-strong`), and a borderless chip hovered or pressed on the grey canvas loses its fill and only its label remains. The disabled fill, `bg-surface-disabled-subtle` (`neutral.50`), is 1.04:1 against both canvases, so the grey disabled label carries the state.

### Border — `chip/border-*` (painted only when `Show border` is on)

| Selected | Default | Hover | Pressed | Disabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| False | `color.border` | `color.border` | `color.border-strong` | `color.border-disabled-subtle` |
| True | `color.border-brand` | `color.border-brand-hover` | `color.border-brand-pressed` | `color.border-disabled-subtle` |

### Text and icons

| Token | Value | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `chip/label-unselected-default` | `color.text-secondary` | Label, unselected, every enabled state. It does not change on hover or pressed. The same grey as the secondary line, so label and secondary text are told apart by weight and size, not colour. |
| `chip/label-selected-default` | `color.text-brand` | Label, selected, Default and Focus |
| `chip/label-selected-hover` | `color.text-brand-on-bg-surface-hover` | Label, selected, Hover |
| `chip/label-selected-pressed` | `color.text-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed` | Label, selected, Pressed |
| `chip/label-disabled` | `color.text-disabled` | Label, Disabled |
| `chip/secondary-text-default` | `color.text-secondary` | Secondary line, every enabled state |
| `chip/secondary-text-disabled` | `color.text-disabled` | Secondary line, Disabled |
| `chip/icon-unselected-default` | `color.icon-secondary` | Leading icon, trailing icon, remove glyph — unselected |
| `chip/icon-selected-default` | `color.icon-brand` | The same, selected |
| `chip/icon-disabled` | `color.icon-disabled` | The same, Disabled |
| `chip/focus-ring` | `color.border-focus` | Chip ring and remove-button ring |

The leading image is never recoloured.

### Remove button — `chip/remove-bg-*`

A circle behind the remove glyph, painted only while the remove button itself is hovered or pressed; transparent otherwise.

| Selected | Hover | Pressed |
|---|---|---|
| False | `color.bg-fill-pressed-strong` | `color.bg-fill-pressed-strong` |
| True | `color.bg-surface-brand-pressed` | `color.bg-surface-brand-pressed` |

Disabled collapses to the neutral ramp whether or not the chip is selected — an inert chip should not still read as chosen.

## Accessibility

### Contrast

Disabled pairs are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11 and are not listed.

| Pair | Ratio | Required | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Label and icons `#525252` on white / hover and pressed `#F5F5F5` | 7.81 / 7.16:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Selected label `#0067E8` on `#EDF8FF` | 4.74:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Selected hover label `#0857C5` on `#D6EFFF` | 5.55:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Selected pressed label `#0D4C9B` on `#C2E8FF` | 6.44:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Secondary `#525252`, lowest pair (on `#C2E8FF`) | 6.05:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Selected icon `#0067E8`, lowest pair (on `#C2E8FF`) | 3.96:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Selected border `#0067E8` on white / grey canvas | 5.11 / 4.69:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Focus ring `#0681FF` on white / grey canvas | 3.75 / 3.44:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Unselected border `#D4D4D4` on white | 1.48:1 | – | See below |

The unselected border is a divider-weight grey on purpose. A chip is identified by its label, not its edge, so 1.4.11 does not require the boundary to reach 3:1 — the same reasoning that lets a white card sit on the grey page at 1.09:1. If research shows chips are being missed, `color.border-strong` (`neutral.500`, 4.74:1) is the stronger edge to switch to. The border keeps this grey on hover and darkens to `border-strong` only while pressed.

### Selection must not rely on colour alone

With the border on, a selected chip changes fill, border and label colour together. With the border off on the grey canvas, the selected fill `#EDF8FF` is 1.01:1 against `#F5F5F5`, so **only the label colour** signals selection — grey `#525252` to blue `#0067E8`, just 1.52:1 apart, well under the 3:1 difference that colour alone would need (WCAG 1.4.1). **A borderless selected filter chip must therefore show a non-colour cue: a check in the leading icon slot** (example 2). With the border on, the blue outline carries the change and the check is recommended rather than required. The token set cannot enforce this; it is a usage rule.

### Semantics

| Chip use | Web | iOS / VoiceOver | Android / TalkBack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Filter (multi-select) | `<button aria-pressed="true\|false">` | Button trait, `.isSelected` when selected | `Modifier.toggleable` / `FilterChip`, `selected` |
| Choice (single-select in a group) | `role="radiogroup"` on the row, `role="radio"` + `aria-checked` on each chip, arrow-key roving focus | Button trait + `.isSelected`, group labelled | `Modifier.selectable` with `Role.RadioButton` inside `selectableGroup()` |
| Action or menu trigger (trailing chevron) | `<button aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded>` | Button trait, hint "Opens menu" | `Role.DropdownList` / button |
| Removable | Chip as above, plus a separate `<button aria-label="Remove {label}">` | Two elements: the chip, and a "Remove {label}" button | Two focusable nodes; remove button `contentDescription = "Remove {label}"` |

The secondary text joins the accessible name after the label ("Fri, 12 Dec, Rs 4,532"). The leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph are presentational. The leading image needs alt text only when it carries information the label does not; an airline logo beside the airline name is decorative (`alt=""`).

**Focus order.** One stop per chip; a removable chip has two, chip first, then its remove button. After removal, move focus to the next chip, or to the previous one when the last chip is removed — never drop it to the top of the page.

**Precedence.** `disabled` wins: a disabled chip is not selectable, and its remove button is inert and out of the tab order.

**Touch target.** The chip hugs its content, so Small (28) and Medium (32) are below the 44/48 minimum. Expand the hit area in code to `chip/min-touch-target` (48) with padding or a pseudo-element, without changing the visible chip or the gap between chips. The remove glyph (16–24) must expand to at least `chip/remove-min-touch-target` (24, WCAG 2.5.8), and that area must not overlap the chip own hit area. Neither is modelled in Figma.

---

## Known gaps

- **Selection by colour alone when borderless.** See Accessibility. Mitigated by the check-icon usage rule, not enforced.
- **No truncation or max width.** The chip grows with its label. Long labels should truncate with an ellipsis at a product-defined max width; no token exists for it yet.
- **Leading image is not dimmed when disabled.** Disabled is a solid colour change in Cosmos, never an opacity, and an image cannot be recoloured. Desaturate it in code if needed.
- **Icon and image are both allowed on at once.** Figma booleans cannot enforce exclusivity; the component description and this spec say to use one.
- **Hover and pressed backgrounds of the remove button are shared tokens today** (`remove-bg-*-hover` and `-pressed` resolve to the same colour). They are separate keys so they can diverge.
- **Chip group layout is out of scope.** Wrapping vs horizontal scrolling, the gap between chips, and single-select keyboard behaviour belong to a future Chip group pattern.
- **`chip/focus-ring-offset` is not bound in Figma.** As on Checkbox, the 4 px outset is ring geometry, not a bindable property. The ring radius binds `chip/focus-ring-radius-*`.
- **No dark mode.** All variable collections are single-mode.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** Hand-authored next to the Figma build. Re-run the `create-component-md` flow to replace it with an extracted spec.

## Token reference

61 tokens under `component.chip` in `tokens/tokens.json` are used by this set, mirrored 1:1 as `chip/*` in the Figma `component` collection. The remaining 16 `chip/vertical-*` tokens belong to [Chip / Vertical](chip-vertical.md).

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| `bg-*` | 8 |
| `border-*` (colour) | 8 |
| `label-*` / `secondary-text-*` | 7 |
| `icon-*` (colour) | 3 |
| `remove-bg-*` | 4 |
| `focus-ring` (colour) | 1 |
| dimensions (`min-height`, `padding-x`, `padding-y`, `gap`, `icon-size`, `image-size`, `radius`, `image-radius`, `image-radius-square`, `gap-text`, `border-width`, `focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset`, `focus-ring-radius`, `min-touch-target`, `remove-min-touch-target`) | 30 |

Platform names follow the standard pipeline: `chip/bg-selected-hover` → `--chip-bg-selected-hover` (CSS) → `CosmosTokens.chipBgSelectedHover` (Swift / Kotlin) → `tokens.chipBgSelectedHover` (TS).

This component also added semantic tokens: **`color.bg-fill-hover`** (`{color.neutral.100}`) and **`color.bg-fill-pressed-subtle`** (`{color.neutral.100}`) — the neutral hover and light pressed steps of `bg-fill` — and later **`color.bg-fill-pressed-strong`** (`{color.neutral.200}`) for presses that must read on either canvas, such as the remove button. Reuse them for Input fields and list rows rather than reaching for a disabled or canvas colour.
